title: fix(cli): doctor's Environment files row names os serve / os start as its loaders in the source posture (#22249)
body:
Fixes #22249
Clause-②: no

## What changed

In the source checkout `os dev` serves, `os doctor`'s `Environment files` row now says whose `.env*` cascade it resolved: `os serve` / `os start`. The source checkout is `nodeEnvSourcePosture`: an `objectstack.config.ts` that boots as itself, alone or beside its own `dist/objectstack.json`. This carries out triage route **A** (comment 6057410828) under #5387's standing ruling. Doctor still resolves the cascade exactly as `os serve` does, and only the row's wording in that posture changes.

- `environmentSourcesCheck(reading, env, opts)` takes `opts.sourcePosture`, the same option shape as `nodeEnvCheck`. Its default is `false`, which gives the unchanged row.
- `run()` now calls `nodeEnvSourcePosture(cwd)` once and hands the answer to both the sources row and the `NODE_ENV` row. Before, the `NODE_ENV` row computed it inline. It is still the one call site in `doctor.ts`, so the posture is not recomputed.
- `doctorNodeEnv()`, `readDotenvFiles()` and the overlay are untouched, so every env-derived verdict is the same in every posture.
- Naming `os start` is true for any `NODE_ENV`. `start.ts` loads `.env*` for `NODE_ENV === 'test' ? 'test' : (NODE_ENV || 'production')`, the same expression `serve.ts` uses without `--dev` and the one `doctorNodeEnv()` mirrors.

## Measured: the rows, before and after

I ran the real `Doctor` command class from source with `tsx` and `NODE_ENV` unset, in five fixture directories. Before is base `fdfdd7e76`, with `doctor.ts` restored to it in the working tree. After is `c76e46354`.

Source posture, a freshly scaffolded project (config only, no `.env*`):

```text
before  ✓ Environment files    No .env* files here (node_env=production) — environment read from this process only — no environment input set
after   ✓ Environment files    No .env* files here (node_env=production, the cascade `os serve` / `os start` load) — environment read from this process only — no environment input set
        ✓ NODE_ENV             Not set — os dev runs this project as development; os start forces production
```

Source posture with comment-only `.env.production` and `.env.development` files. The listed file shows the cascade did not move:

```text
before  ✓ Environment files    .env.production (node_env=production), the cascade `os serve` loads — no environment input set
after   ✓ Environment files    .env.production (node_env=production), the cascade `os serve` / `os start` load — no environment input set
```

Controls: an artifact-only project (`dist/objectstack.json`, no config), an empty directory, and a config beside an `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` naming another artifact. All three rows are byte-identical before and after (`diff` empty; sha256 of the three rows `7c5ce42e16f56430…` on both sides):

```text
✓ Environment files    No .env* files here (node_env=production) — environment read from this process only — no environment input set
```

## Tests

New cases, all in `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor-node-env-default.test.ts` (unit tier):

- Unit, `environmentSourcesCheck`, for both row shapes (no file, a `.env` file):
  - in the source posture the message names `os serve` and `os start` beside `node_env=production`;
  - **control:** `{ sourcePosture: false }` equals the posture-less call field for field, and does not name `os start`;
  - the posture moves only the wording: `status`, `fix` and the closing provenance clause are equal across postures.
- End to end (`Doctor.run`):
  - **(f)** the scaffold's sources row names `os serve` / `os start` beside `node_env=production`, directly above the `os dev` `NODE_ENV` row;
  - **(g)** with `.env.production` and `.env.development` present, the row lists the production file and not the development one;
  - **controls (h), empty directory, artifact-only project:** each row ends with exactly the posture-less `environmentSourcesCheck(...)` message and does not name `os start`.

H3 from the dispatch was measured partly false. The existing pins on this row (`doctor-env-provenance.test.ts`, `doctor-config-env-overlay.test.ts`) assert substrings such as `No .env* files here` and `node_env=production`, not the full row text. So the byte-identity control is carried by the new pins above and by the one-off measurement, not by those pins. All of them stay green.

**Reverse verification.** With the fix committed, I restored `doctor.ts` to base `fdfdd7e76` in the working tree only (on-disk hash `14b8e959…` equal to the base blob, marker count 0). Direction observed: red as expected. 4 of the 11 new cases failed, namely both unit source-posture cases plus e2e (f) and (g). All 7 controls stayed green (`Tests 4 failed | 30 passed (34)`). The restore leg was `git checkout HEAD --`: hash `01415add…` equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, status clean. The subject resolves through source (`./doctor.js` relative import), not `dist/`, so no rebuild was needed for either leg.

Runs, all on `c76e46354`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose src/commands/doctor-node-env-default.test.ts`: `Tests 34 passed (34)`.
- The three files that read this row (`doctor-node-env-default`, `doctor-env-provenance`, `doctor-config-env-overlay`): `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 68 passed (68)`.
- The `@objectstack/cli` unit layer (`vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`): `268 passed | 2 failed (270)`. The 2 failures were `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` and `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`, which threw `packages/cli is not built` (a prerequisite, not a measurement). Re-run after the workspace build, both passed (`Tests 29 passed (29)`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`). `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.json` counts the edited test file in the program (1 of 1526 files).
- **Integration layer:** declared to CI. The diff reaches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry.

## Gates

All of these were run on `c76e46354`, the final commit, after the workspace build (`pnpm turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2`: `72 successful, 72 total`).

- **Derived families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`, with no paths (change set taken from the merge base `fdfdd7e76`), gives 64 commands. That list is identical to the dispatch's lead list (sorted `diff` empty). **All 64 exit 0.** Reconciled with `--ran` (each line carrying its recorded exit): `64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 64 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
  - A first pass ran before the workspace build. In it, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`), which is not a measurement. In the second pass, after the build, all four measured green. For example, `check-i18n-bundles: OK (9 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`.
  - Some verdict lines: `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 10382 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)`; `check-adr-0087-registration: this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (1 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)`; `No empty-frontmatter changeset introduced by this diff (1 declaring changeset(s) added)`.
  - Locally, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` reports its clause-② level axis as NOT APPLICABLE because there is no `pull_request` payload. CI reads this body's `Clause-②: no` line.
- **`pnpm lint`** (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, whole repository, not narrowed): exit 0, no findings.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`**: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Claim file surface.** The claim (6073648874) places the doctor pins under `packages/cli/test/`, but they live in `packages/cli/src/commands/`. The new cases were added to the file the claim names, `doctor-node-env-default.test.ts`, where it actually is.
- **Noted, not filed.** In the source posture with only `.env.development` present (for example `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` in it), the row still opens `No .env* files here (node_env=production, the cascade …)`. It also says `no environment input set`. That is correct under #5387 for the production cascade, and the new parenthetical now says which cascade, but the opening words read literally false beside a `.env.development`. Rewording `No .env* files here` is outside route A's single clause. No carrier.
- `#22163`'s pending changeset still says the row "still reports the `.env*` cascade for `node_env=production`". That stays true; this PR's changeset adds the loader wording and does not edit that file.
